script_text: Pluto in your 1st House electrifies your ruling planet Uranus this week, Aquarius, so expect your Air sign mind to crack under pressure. Tuesday is your power day. Friday is your worst day because career and romance clash. Carry a notebook to capture Uranus insights before they disappear. Follow for daily updates.
